summary: Completed comprehensive frontend UI testing of Lowkey Next.js app premium nightlife-themed UI refresh. All 10 features tested and verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data - 4+ lounges and founder account
context_for_next_testing_agent: All premium nightlife UI features verified working. Login has gold theme with animated background. Home page has People Online section with circular avatars and green dots, Active Lounges with lounge cards, Quick Access section, and bottom navigation. Lounge list page has search, stats, FAB button, and lounge cards with all required elements.
